title: Base Substitution Analysis and Redox State Response
summary: This cluster revolves around the analysis of base substitutions in genomes and their relationship to redox states. Genome-Wide Base Substitution Analysis is involved in various base substitution methods, including C > A, C > G, and C > T. Low DO and High DO are associated with these methods and are enriched in detoxification and oxidoreductase activity, respectively. Intracellular ROS measures are linked to antioxidant enzyme activity and direct ROS measurement. The cluster also explores the response to base substitutions, including substitution-class-dependent response, mismatch-rate and candidate variant-rate analyses, and mixed transcriptome-fidelity response models.
